name: N Cable
summary: Regional cable TV + cable internet + dialup provider (Neighborhood Cable, ~2000); note: distinct from Neighbourhood Cable Ltd entity - verify (ACN 000 042 295).

events.details: Acquired by TransACT — Neighbourhood Cable brand replaced by TransACT.

refs.label: Documents the 2007 acquisition and the mid-2011 brand retirement.
Still the Neighbourhood Cable site in Feb 2011.
By 6 Jul 2011 ncable.net.au served the TransACT homepage, confirming the rebrand.
The ACN cited in the brief resolves to a TransACT entity, corroborating the acquirer.
ABR: NEIGHBOURHOOD CABLE LIMITED (RENAMED TRANSACT VICTORIA HOLDINGS PTY LTD IN 2011) ACN 000 042 295
